entries.note: from SDK matrix mapkit.json Refreshed 2026-10-17: Still open: no map renderer or tile source, no annotations or overlays, city-level reverse geocoding only, no SDK routing API, and no IMDF parsing. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Map camera and region, view interaction, annotations and overlays, geometry types, place items, point-of-interest filters, routes, maps links and GeoJSON are in the kit; tiles come from the maptiles loader (a configurable OpenStreetMap-compatible source with request pacing, an on-disk cache and offline areas, shared by the Maps app and the shell) and place search from its geocoder. Built this wave: bifrost_app::map_snapshotter composes a snapshot (tiles, routes, pins) from any TileSource, and TileDirectory reads the loader's cache layout, so an app gets a map image without writing its own compositor. Open: IMDF indoor maps; routing needs an OSRM-compatible server the app configures; reverse geocoding is city level.

entries.name: Matter
entries.note: Left partial, beyond one agent: the controller needs the Matter secure channel (PASE with SPAKE2+ and CASE with operational certificates), a TLV and message layer, and the IP and BLE transports for commissioning, plus Thread credentials. Built and tested: setup payload (QR and manual code) parsing, DNS-SD name and TXT parsing with discovery through the local Avahi daemon (avahi_browse), fabric and controller state, the interaction model (read, write, invoke, subscribe paths) and typed cluster data, all re-exported by bifrost_app. Reviewed 2026-10-17 (wave 13): the audited crypto for PASE and CASE is the missing engine.

entries.name: MatterSupport
entries.note: n/a: MatterSupport is the extension point through which a smart-home ecosystem app (the reference platform's Home) adds an accessory during its own setup flow (MatterAddDeviceRequest and its extension request handler, run as an app extension that hands Thread and Wi-Fi credentials from the ecosystem). BifrOSt has no extension host for ecosystem apps and no Apple Home-style ecosystem; apps that commission accessories use the Matter controller rows directly. Evidence: the framework holds only the add-device request and extension handler types.

entries.name: MediaAccessibility
entries.note: from SDK matrix media-accessibility.json Refreshed 2026-10-17: flashing-lights dimming is covered (springboard/ui/src/flashing_lights.rs; SDK DisplayOptions.dim_flashing_lights). Still open: caption and audible media preferences as an app API and a settings page, subtitle tracks in the demuxers, and image caption metadata. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Caption appearance profiles with change reporting, caption and audible media track selection from the preferences, flashing-lights dimming (shell setting, service and SDK option) and image caption metadata are in the kit and bifrost_app. Music haptics is n/a on PC hardware. Open: a Settings page for caption appearance and subtitle tracks in the demuxers.

entries.name: MediaExtension

entries.ready_note: Format readers, track readers and sample cursors, video decoder registration by codec type, RAW processing parameters and the extension declaration with its entitlement are in the kit and bifrost_app::media_extension; the shell's demuxers and the libavcodec decoder are the built-in implementations behind the same seams. Open: out-of-process loading of a third-party reader or decoder in a sandbox.

entries.name: MediaIntelligence
entries.note: Left partial: face detection and embedding need a face model and BifrOSt ships no open one (the reference models are its own ML packs). Built and tested: face grouping and queries from caller-supplied embeddings, the on-device runtime (ml_runtime), and this wave VideoAnalyzer, which measures decoded frames (luma histogram, motion) and answers the highlight segment and key frame requests with no model. Needs an open face detector and embedder to finish.

entries.ready_note: The audio search request with criteria and filters, resolution with disambiguation and confirmation, playback request dialogs, typed intents and entity queries, and now-playing publication are in bifrost_app (media_intents, intents) and the kit. Open: delivery of requests from a voice assistant (BifrOSt has none by design) and launching an app to answer an intent while it is closed.

entries.name: Metal

entries.note: Checked 2026-10-17: springboard/gpu/Cargo.toml loads Vulkan through ash (loaded feature), so the device comes from libvulkan.so.1 (vulkan-icd-loader, in gpu_packages). The vendor ICDs are chosen per detected GPU by springboard/src/installer/plan.rs gpu_packages: vulkan-intel for Intel, vulkan-radeon for AMD, nvidia-open and nvidia-utils for NVIDIA. Apps get no GPU API, so the row stays partial. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: bifrost-gpu is the Metal-shaped API over Vulkan 1.3 (device, textures, buffers, command queues and buffers, render and compute encoders, pipelines and samplers, shared events, dma-buf import and export), re-exported to apps as bifrost_app::gpu this wave; the vendor drivers come from the installer's gpu_packages. The kit models command buffers, shader libraries, compute grids and blits. Open: GPU ray tracing and tensor passes (the CPU graph runs in the kit).

entries.name: Network
entries.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/network_stream.rs; springboard/sdk/src/network_connection.rs; springboard/sdk/src/network_listener.rs; springboard/sdk/src/network_group.rs; springboard/sdk/src/network_path.rs; springboard/sdk/src/avahi_browse.rs; springboard/sdk/src/tls_client.rs; springboard/sdk/src/url.rs; springboard/core/src/net_connection.rs; springboard/core/src/net_path.rs; springboard/core/src/websocket.rs; springboard/core/src/dns_browse.rs
entries.note: from SDK matrix network.json Refreshed 2026-10-17 (still open): No app-facing TCP client: sdk network_connection (Endpoint, Parameters, Connection) is a model that opens no socket; sdk network_listener and network_group bind real sockets for apps; Service browse has no socket query: sdk network_browser and core dns_browse take replies fed in by hand; No QUIC, WebSocket or custom protocol framer; No NWPathMonitor-style object: sdk network_path requests and decodes the shell path and DNS-SD replies, but no app subscribes to interface changes; TLS client options map to a rustls config (sdk tls_client); no client identities or TLS metadata for apps; No packet trace or network inspector for apps Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Built this wave: bifrost_app::network_stream::NetworkStream is the connection with a socket behind it (TCP with the TCP options, TLS through tls_client, UDP, local path; state ready, failed, cancelled) and avahi_browse fills a service Browser from the Avahi daemon. With URLSession for HTTP, listeners, multicast groups, WebSocket framing, path monitoring and the TLS options model these cover the framework. Open: QUIC, custom protocol framers and a packet trace for apps; client identities for TLS.

entries.name: NetworkExtension
entries.bifrost: springboard/core/src/tun_device.rs; springboard/core/src/tunnel.rs; springboard/core/src/vpn_profiles.rs; springboard/core/src/relay.rs; springboard/core/src/content_filter.rs; springboard/core/src/dns_settings.rs; springboard/core/src/dns_proxy.rs; springboard/core/src/local_push.rs; springboard/ui/src/url_filter.rs; springboard/sdk/src/packet_tunnel.rs; springboard/sdk/src/hotspot_configuration.rs

entries.ready_note: Built this wave: the packet tunnel host (core tun_device: a Linux tun interface that moves whole IP packets, the ip commands that address it, and the full-tunnel and split-tunnel route plan with the server and excluded networks kept on the uplink), exposed as bifrost_app::packet_tunnel with the session life cycle, profiles and route policy. The relay, content filter, URL filter, DNS settings, DNS proxy and local push provider models and the Wi-Fi configuration model were already tested. A custom provider supplies its own protocol; IKEv2 and IPsec negotiation are not in tree, and applying a Wi-Fi configuration to the supplicant stays shell-only.

entries.name: NotificationCenter
entries.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/widget.rs; springboard/ui/src/widget_list.rs; springboard/ui/src/widget_search.rs; springboard/ui/src/widget_column.rs; springboard/sdk/src/today_widgets.rs; springboard/src/shell/services/widgets_timeline.rs; springboard/src/shell/today.rs
entries.note: Refreshed 2026-10-17, still open: No app-drawn widget content: springboard/sdk/src/today_widgets.rs (WidgetSet) sets the order and the has-content flags only, and the shell draws its own widgets (NCWidgetProviding). No search results view or list view for widgets (NCWidgetSearchViewController, NCWidgetListViewController). The Notification Center column does not show widgets: springboard/src/shell/notify/center.rs says the shell has no widget data source on the PC yet. The layout model in springboard/ui/src/widget_column.rs exists but nothing calls it yet. WidgetKit (Apple's replacement) is not in the SDK; it is outside this framework but is where Apple's widget work now lives. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Today widgets: the provider and controller models (display modes, margin insets, has-content), the list and search views and the column layout are in the kit, and apps feed the widget area through the widgets_timeline service (timeline entries with reload policy, search results, live activities) that the shell draws in the Today view with editing and ordering. The reference framework is deprecated in favour of timelines, which is the path BifrOSt follows.

Entries, activities, signposts, boundaries, enumerator and position tokens, and format payloads are not built. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Logging is built: springboard/core/src/log.rs (LogStore read side, Logger write side, subsystem registry) behind bifrost_app::log, the bifrost-log CLI and the Console app. Journald is the store.

entries.name: OpenAL
entries.note: The audio service plays and captures PCM streams. Built 2026-10-17: a positional source model in the SDK (sdk positional_audio::tests) with inverse-distance gain and equal-power pan. Gap: the model is not wired to audiod playback, and there are no per-source streams. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Built this wave: bifrost_app::audio_scene::Scene is the OpenAL-shaped context: buffers (mono positioned, stereo as recorded), sources with position, distance model, relative mode, gain, pitch and looping, the source life cycle (initial, playing, paused, stopped), a listener, and a mixer that renders interleaved stereo with sample-rate conversion and clipping. The app writes the blocks to the audio service. Open: Doppler shift, multichannel buffers and per-source effects.

entries.name: OpenCL
entries.bifrost: springboard/src/installer/plan.rs (gpu_packages adds opencl-mesa for Intel and AMD)
entries.note: Provided at the system layer: springboard/src/installer/plan.rs gpu_packages adds opencl-mesa (mesa's rusticl OpenCL driver) for Intel and AMD, and a test pins it (installer::plan::tests::gpu_packages_follow_the_hardware). NVIDIA keeps its own OpenCL stack, which gpu_packages does not add. Apps get no compute SDK, so the row stays partial until an SDK surface exists. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The system provides OpenCL: the installer adds opencl-mesa (mesa rusticl) for Intel and AMD GPUs, and the test pins the package choice. NVIDIA keeps its own OpenCL stack. No compute API reaches apps, so the row describes the system layer only.

entries.name: OpenDirectory
entries.note: from SDK matrix open-directory.json Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Directory sessions and nodes, record queries with asynchronous results, the local account directory and LDAP nodes (through the installed openldap tools, bifrost_app::ldap_directory) are offered to apps, with contact search over a directory in the kit. BifrOSt has one local account and no directory-backed sign-in, so account policies and password verification of other accounts are n/a by design.

entries.name: OpenGL
entries.bifrost: packaging/arch/runtime-packages.txt (mesa); springboard/src/installer/plan.rs (libglvnd, gpu_packages); springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (/dev/dri for native apps); springboard/src/gpu/egl.rs
entries.note: Checked 2026-10-17: springboard/src/gpu/egl.rs dlopens libEGL.so.1 and libGLESv2.so.2 (DESKTOP_LIBS). The installer puts libglvnd in the base list (springboard/src/installer/plan.rs BASE_PACKAGES) and mesa from gpu_packages, which also provides the DRI drivers and libgbm (on the host, libEGL.so.1 is owned by libglvnd and dispatches to mesa's libEGL_mesa.so). Apps get no GL SDK surface, so the row stays partial. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: OpenGL and OpenGL ES are Mesa through libglvnd: native Linux apps in the app sandbox get the DRI render nodes (/dev/dri) and link libGL, libEGL and libGLESv2 directly, and the shell's own presenter uses the same libraries. SDK apps that draw on the GPU use bifrost_app::gpu (Vulkan) instead; the reference platform's legacy GL API has no separate SDK layer by design.

entries.name: MDSChannel
entries.note: Client channel to the metadata server (mds) that indexes files for search. Name-based reading: the bundle holds only Info.plist and a localised name. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Apps reach the shell's content index over the control channel (SearchIndex and SearchDelete into spotindex, queries through quicksearch and metadata_query). Name-based mapping: the reference binary is not readable, so the lead should confirm the job.

entries.name: MFAAuthentication
entries.note: Two-factor sign-in for the reference vendor's account, served by its network XPC service (MFAANetwork). BifrOSt Cloud runs its own sign-in, so the vendor's flow has no counterpart.

entries.name: MFiAuthentication
entries.note: Authentication for the reference vendor's certified accessory chips (its accessory certification program). BifrOSt has no such program, and the component has no meaning on PC hardware.

entries.name: MIL
entries.note: Model intermediate language used by the reference on-device ML compiler. BifrOSt has no model compiler or model format, so the row does not apply.

entries.name: MLAssetIO
entries.note: Apple on-device machine-learning runtime and its model assets. BifrOSt runs no Apple model packs or Core ML inference, so there is no equivalent to build.

entries.name: MLCompilerRuntime
entries.note: Runtime for the reference on-device model compiler. BifrOSt has no model compiler stack, and the reference format it compiles is Apple-only.

entries.name: MLCompilerServices
entries.note: XPC compile service for the reference on-device model compiler (MLCompilerOSXPC). BifrOSt has no model compiler stack, so the row does not apply.

entries.name: MLIR_ML
entries.note: MLIR-based ML toolchain of the reference, with its model viewer tool. BifrOSt has no model compiler stack, so the row does not apply.

entries.name: MLModelAsset
entries.note: Model asset packaging for the reference on-device ML (com.apple.ggml.ModelAsset). It is an Apple model-pack format that BifrOSt does not use.

entries.name: MLModelCache
entries.note: Apple on-device machine-learning runtime and its model assets. BifrOSt runs no Apple model packs or Core ML inference, so there is no equivalent to build.

entries.name: MLModelSpecification
entries.note: Model file format specification of the reference on-device ML. BifrOSt has no model format, so the row does not apply.

entries.name: MLRuntime
entries.note: Apple on-device machine-learning runtime and its model assets. BifrOSt runs no Apple model packs or Core ML inference, so there is no equivalent to build.

entries.name: MMCS
entries.note: Content transfer for the reference vendor's cloud sync (bundle com.apple.cloudkit.MMCS). It serves that vendor's cloud storage, which BifrOSt Cloud does not use this way.

entries.name: MMCSServices
entries.note: XPC services behind the reference vendor's cloud content transfer (com.apple.mmcsservices). BifrOSt has no vendor cloud sync, so it has no counterpart.

entries.name: MSGExternalSync
entries.note: Reopened from n/a (audit 2026-10-17): purpose unknown. Bare framework (Info.plist 1413 B only). By name external-account sync for the messaging stack (MSG prefix), which may be a local sync engine for mail or chat accounts. BifrOSt Messages is a Matrix client and Mail syncs over IMAP and DAV (dav_sync), so a partial counterpart may exist. Needs: strings and callers.

entries.name: MSUDataAccessor
entries.note: The shell checks for and applies over-the-air OS updates from the update manifest. The reference's data accessor for software update catalogues is not mirrored, so apps get no update data API. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The shell checks for and applies OS updates (shell::ota, 25 tests). The reference catalogue accessor is not covered.

entries.name: MTInferenceToolLib
entries.note: Inference tooling library of the reference model toolchain, used by Apple's internal tools. It has no BifrOSt meaning.

entries.name: MTL3On4
entries.note: n/a: compatibility layer that runs the vendor's Metal 3 API on its Metal 4 driver for its own GPUs. BifrOSt has no Metal and no vendor GPU driver; the gpu crate talks to Vulkan directly.

entries.name: MTLCompiler
entries.note: Shaders are GLSL that build.rs compiles to SPIR-V at build time and embeds in the binary. The reference compiles shaders at run time in a compiler service, and BifrOSt has no run-time shader compiler or app shader API. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Shaders are GLSL compiled to SPIR-V at build time (bifrost-gpu shader, tested). Run-time compilation in a compiler service is not mirrored.

entries.name: MTLSimDriver
entries.note: Simulator driver for the reference vendor's developer simulator (XPC host MTLSimDriverHost). It has no meaning on a PC desktop.

entries.name: MTLSimImplementation
entries.note: Simulator implementation of the GPU API for the reference vendor's developer simulator. It has no meaning on a PC desktop.

entries.name: MXI
entries.note: n/a: Metal shader archives for the vendor's GPUs (the index lists mxi_archive.metallib of 45 MB and default.metallib, and CoreRE has a mxi.metallib). They are compiled for the vendor's silicon and cannot run on Vulkan; BifrOSt writes its own shaders in springboard/ui/src/shaders.

entries.name: MacMailSearchProcessing
entries.note: Mail indexes the newest 200 messages of the open mailbox into the shell Core Search index (index::plan, fed by MailApp::index_tick), with subject, people, date, state keywords, list and mailbox fields. Search query parsing with field filters is in search.rs. Remaining: only the open mailbox is indexed (no background indexing of other mailboxes), message bodies are not indexed, and there is no persistent on-disk mail index outside the shell store. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Host tests index::tests cover the item fields, the id round trip, the plan (new, changed, gone, other mailboxes untouched, row cap, setting off) and re-indexing on read or flag change; search::tests cover query parsing.

entries.name: MacSystemUI
entries.note: The menu bar, dock and control centre are drawn by the shell, so the system chrome exists. Not mirrored: a shared chrome library that other apps link, and extension points for third-party items. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The menu bar, dock and control centre are drawn by the shell (shell::desktop_bar, shell::desktop_dock, shell::control_center), tested. A shared chrome library for other apps is not covered.

entries.name: MachineSettings
entries.note: The Settings app with its pages and search is in the shell. Not covered: a framework that other apps use to add their own settings panes. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The Settings app with its pages and search (shell::settings, shell::settings_search), tested. A framework for apps to add panes is not covered.

entries.name: MacinTalk
entries.note: Text to speech runs through the speech service: apps speak an utterance with a voice and rate, and the say tool and the screen reader use the same engine, espeak-ng, which is now in packaging/arch/runtime-packages.txt. Gap: no word or sentence events, no pitch or volume, and the reference voice catalogue is not mirrored. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The speech stack is built: engine programs and voice parsing (springboard/core/src/speech_engine.rs), the speech service (springboard/src/shell/services/speech.rs), the SDK speech API (springboard/sdk/src/speech.rs) and the say tool (springboard/cmd/src/say.rs). espeak-ng is in runtime-packages.txt.

entries.name: MacinTalkCore
entries.note: The speech core (engine programs, voice and rate arguments, voice listing parser) is in springboard/core/src/speech_engine.rs and drives espeak-ng. Gap: the reference voice catalogue and its synthesis are not mirrored. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The speech stack is built: engine programs and voice parsing (springboard/core/src/speech_engine.rs), the speech service (springboard/src/shell/services/speech.rs), the SDK speech API (springboard/sdk/src/speech.rs) and the say tool (springboard/cmd/src/say.rs). espeak-ng is in runtime-packages.txt.

entries.name: MagnifierServices

entries.ready_note: The shell magnifier zoom (shell::magnifier), tested. The reference zoom service process is not mirrored.

entries.name: MagnifierSupport
entries.note: The shell magnifier zooms the screen from magnifier.rs. Not mirrored: the reference support code for the zoom feature and its app intents. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The shell magnifier zoom (shell::magnifier), tested. The reference support code and app intents are not mirrored.

entries.name: Mail
entries.note: The Mail app has accounts, the window, IMAP and SMTP transport. Not mirrored: a shared mail framework that other apps link. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Mail window, IMAP and SMTP transport in mail-desktop, tested. A shared mail framework for other apps is not covered.

entries.name: MailCore
entries.note: Message headers, MIME parsing and draft rendering are in mail-desktop. Not covered: a shared mail model that other apps can open mailboxes through. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Message headers and MIME parsing in mail-desktop (message, mime), tested. A shared mail model for other apps is not covered.

entries.name: MailSearchSchemaManifest
entries.note: The schema of an indexed message is the SCHEMA manifest in mail-desktop/src/index.rs: subject, from, recipients, date, unread, flagged, list, mailbox and account (account unsearchable), each mapped to an attribute of the shell index item (title, authorNames and persons, contentCreationDate, keywords, custom attributes), under domain "mail" and content type public.email-message. Remaining: the shell index stores items rather than typed columns, so the manifest is a mapping, not a schema the shell enforces; body text is not a field. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Tests index::tests::the_schema_names_each_field_once_and_the_item_fills_it, dates_parse_to_unix_seconds and state_keywords_and_rank_follow_the_flags check the manifest and the item it produces.

entries.name: MailService
entries.note: Account sync runs on worker threads in sync.rs while the window is open. Not mirrored: a background mail agent that keeps accounts synced while the app is closed. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Account sync runs on worker threads in the sync module while the window is open. A background agent that keeps accounts synced while closed is not built.

entries.name: MailSupport
entries.note: The Mail window state and preferences are in mail-desktop. Not covered: support services that other mail components call. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Mail window state and preferences (state, prefs), tested. Support services for other components are not covered.

entries.name: MailUI
entries.note: The Mail window's drawing and input are in mail-desktop. Not covered: a shared mail UI kit and the reference's mail web bundle. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Mail window drawing and input (draw, window), tested. A shared mail UI kit is not covered.

entries.name: MailWebProcessSupport
entries.note: HTML mail is cleaned of scripts and remote content in html.rs and rendered in-process. Not mirrored: the reference's separate web process for mail content. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: HTML mail is cleaned of scripts and remote content in mail-desktop html, tested. The separate web process is not mirrored.

entries.name: MallocStackLogging
entries.note: valgrind traces heap allocations and leaks for debugging, which covers the purpose on Linux. It has no switch like the reference allocation logging, and apps get no in-process allocation log. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: valgrind is installed from runtime-packages.txt and traces heap allocations and leaks, which is the job of allocation logging on Linux.

entries.name: MapsSync

Framework with Info.plist (1376 B) and a localised InfoPlist.loctable (4.7 KB) only; the localised bundle display name suggests a user-facing name in some UI. entries.name: MarkupUI

entries.ready_note: Pen and marker annotation for screenshots is in shell::markup, with unit tests. A system Markup extension point is not built.

entries.name: MaterialKit

entries.ready_note: Vibrancy and layer materials in bifrost-render vibrancy and bifrost-layers layer, tested. The reference platter and vibrant style sets are not covered.

entries.name: MathTypesetting
entries.note: Math layout engine in springboard/render/src/math: LaTeX subset and linear input parsed to a tree (frac, sqrt, scripts, big operators with limits, left/right delimiters, matrices, text), laid out with TeX rules (styles, spacing table, fraction, radical, script shifts, stretched delimiters) using OpenType MATH constants when the font has them. Painter in math/paint.rs. Formulas use the installed Noto Sans Math (OFL, noto-fonts-extra) and its MATH table; TeX defaults when the file is missing. Notes renders $...$ inline and $$...$$ display math in markdown mode (shell/textarea.rs). Not done: the Calculator display, and a device check of Notes. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The math layout engine (parser, TeX-rule layout, painter) is in springboard/render/src/math and uses the installed Noto Sans Math font.

entries.name: MatrixKit
entries.note: Reopened from n/a (audit 2026-10-17): purpose unknown. Bare framework (Info.plist 1288 B, version.plist 457 B). Name suggests a matrix or grid support kit; no linking bundle in the index. Needs: exports and callers.

entries.name: MatterPlugin
entries.note: Refreshed 2026-10-17, still open: No Matter controller: no fabric, certificates, commissioning or interaction model, in the shell or the SDK. No Thread support: no border router, no Thread network credentials and no OpenThread stack. No mDNS or DNS-SD transport: springboard/core/src/dns_browse (via sdk network_browser) is a model fed by the caller; it sends no multicast query and no responder answers, so apps cannot browse services. No BLE commissioning path, and no camera or scan source for setup codes. The Bluetooth module handles classic pairing only (springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs). No SDK API or app-facing surface for smart-home accessories, and no Home-style app. Whether BifrOSt should add one is a product decision, not a technical gap. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Matter controller pieces are built: setup code and QR parsing, DNS-SD names, fabric ids, interaction read/write/invoke/subscribe and typed clusters (On/Off, Level Control and others). Commissioning over Thread and certificate storage are open and tracked in the Matter SDK rows.

entries.name: MediaAgnosticUSB
entries.note: n/a: Media Agnostic USB (MA-USB) tunnels USB over a wireless or IP link, as used by wireless docks (name-based; the index holds only Info.plist and version.plist). No PC peripheral BifrOSt targets uses it, Linux has no in-kernel MA-USB, and wired USB is handled by the kernel and sdk usb_device.

Gap: there is no system-wide media daemon for remote devices, and artwork is not carried. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Apps publish a Now Playing session and receive transport commands through the now_playing service, tested. Device-to-device remote control is not covered.

entries.name: MediaRemoteDaemonServices
entries.note: The service side of the Now Playing session (publish, clear and command routing) is the now_playing service. The reference daemon's device-to-device remote is not built. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The service side of the Now Playing session (publish, clear, command routing) in shell::services::now_playing, tested.

entries.name: MediaServices
entries.note: n/a: media-services support for the vendor's store and account services (the index shows the AppleMediaServices tree and the AMSMediaServiceOwner plug-in beside it). Needs the vendor account and stores, which BifrOSt does not mirror.

entries.name: MediaStream
entries.note: Shared media streams (the shared streams service with its sharing push channels). The sharing runs through the reference vendor's push and account services, which BifrOSt does not have.

entries.name: MemoryAccounting
entries.note: Per-process and system memory accounting (footprints, available memory, pressure). Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Activity Monitor reads /proc (meminfo, per-process statm) with tested parsers, and bifrostd publishes the memory pressure level that apps read through memory_pressure. Per-process compressed-memory accounting is not mirrored (Linux has none).

entries.name: MemoryDiagnostics
entries.note: n/a: memory-maintenance reporting of the vendor's diagnostics pipeline (it sends memory and resource-exception reports to the vendor; the index holds only Info.plist and version.plist). BifrOSt sends no diagnostics upload; local crash and memory-pressure data is in crash_report and the pager.

entries.name: MenuBarClient
entries.note: Apps publish menu bar extras (status items) that the shell draws in the menu bar. Gap: the reference menu bar agent's own system extras are not handled through this client, and the framework's bundled extras are not reproduced. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Apps publish menu bar extras that the shell draws (shell::extras), tested.

entries.name: MenuBarClientCore
entries.note: The core side of menu bar extras is covered by the same status-item registry in extras.rs. Gap: the reference framework's extra-layout rules are not reproduced. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The status-item registry in shell::extras, tested. The reference extra-layout rules are not reproduced.

entries.name: MessageProtection
entries.note: Trust store for the reference vendor's message identities . It only has meaning for the vendor's messaging service, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: MessageSecurity
entries.note: Timestamp service for the reference vendor's message signing . It belongs to the vendor's messaging service, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: MessageUIMacHelper
entries.note: Compose-sheet helper for the reference vendor's message and mail compose sheets. BifrOSt Messages is a Matrix client that composes in its own window (springboard/apps/messages-desktop).

entries.name: MessagesBlastDoorSupport
entries.note: Sandboxed parser for the reference vendor's payloads and their language codecs. BifrOSt Messages is a Matrix client and does not parse that format.

entries.name: MessagesCloudSync
entries.note: Sync of message history through the reference vendor's cloud service. BifrOSt has no such cloud service, and its Messages app syncs through Matrix.

entries.name: MessagesEscrow
entries.note: Escrow of message keys in the reference vendor's escrow service, tied to cloud account recovery. BifrOSt has no such service.

entries.name: MessagesHelperKit
entries.note: n/a: helper kit of the Messages app. The index lists only two plug-in bundles (PlugIns/FavoritesController.bundle, PlugIns/FileTransferController.bundle) and MessagesHelperKitLocalizable.loctable: favourites and file transfer inside Messages, which rides on iMessage, an Apple-only protocol with no open equivalent that BifrOSt does not mirror.

entries.name: MessagesKit
entries.note: The Messages app model (rooms, selection, composer and sign-in state) covers the chat job of this framework, as a homeserver client. Gap: the reference conversation, attachment and sync APIs are not mirrored. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The Messages app model (rooms, selection, composer, sign-in state) is tested. It is a homeserver client, not the reference transport.

entries.name: MessagesSecurityPolicy
entries.note: Security policy of Apple's own message service. BifrOSt's Messages app talks to a homeserver, not to that service, so the policy has no meaning here.

entries.name: MessagesSettingsUI
entries.note: Settings for the reference's iCloud Messages sync (the MessagesSettings and iCloudMessagesSettings string tables seen in the reference index). That sync is an Apple account service BifrOSt does not run, so n/a.

entries.name: MetadataUtilities
entries.note: File and item metadata helpers (inferred from the name; the index lists only Info.plist, version.plist and the binary link). BifrOSt builds the metadata queries, the command-line finder and the search index in its own modules. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Host tests for the metadata query model (predicates on name, kind, size, time and named attributes, sorting), the mdfind command and the per-app search index. The job is inferred from the name, not read from the reference binary.

entries.name: MetalMetrics
entries.note: The counter model in counter_sample covers the sampling side of GPU profiling that this framework feeds (data/metal.json). Gap: no hardware GPU counters are read on the desktop path. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The counter model (bifrost-ui counter_sample) that GPU profiling feeds, tested. Hardware GPU counters are not covered.
